derivation.independentObservationRule: Keep the first chronological receipt for each archive SHA-256; preserve but exclude byte-identical receipts from numeric extrema and transitions.
derivation.gapAndFailureRule: Do not impute missing or rejected days; compare consecutive distinct complete observations, matching last-known-good baseline behavior.
derivation.countRange: For each scope, observed minimum minus one maximum observed absolute transition and observed maximum plus one maximum observed absolute transition, clamped to zero.
derivation.absoluteChange: Maximum absolute record-count transition across consecutive distinct observations.
derivation.relativeChange: Maximum absolute record-count transition divided by the positive previous count.
derivation.rateAndShareRounding: Compute maxima with Node.js runtime IEEE-754 arithmetic, then round each maximum upward to 12 decimal places.
derivation.missingRates: Maximum observed missing count divided by positive record count.
derivation.statusShareChange: Maximum absolute share transition where both consecutive record counts are positive.
derivation.maxJsonBytes: Maximum of the two interval-end compact staged totals plus their absolute transition: 691143712 + 176253 = 691319965 bytes.
derivation.emptyCategoryRule: Include exactly categories with zero rows in every complete receipt and every distinct observation.

initialBaselineCandidate.selectionRationale: Latest distinct complete interval observation with all 195 categories, current schema and contract versions, and independent hash/transition review.

qa.compactStagingResult: Both interval-end candidates completed non-publishing staging with the proposed numeric limits and a temporary nonbinding size ceiling.

adoptionEffects: Adopt the policy object as ValidationPolicyV1 only after explicit human approval.
Adopt the baseline object only with the same approved policy revision.
Do not treat collection dates or provider modified dates as source coverage.
Do not publish, deploy, or replace known-good data from this proposal.
